# Glyph plane (moved)

## Glyph plane (moved)

This page has moved. There is only one contract, `ilium:plugin@0.1.0`. The glyph plane, owner ids, frame receipts, fonts and pre-rendered loops are described on [Glyph plane and frame receipts](/pages/api-surface-glyph-plane/). The types are defined in the [WIT reference](/pages/reference-wit/) under `ilium:anim/surface`.
